defs.def: connected with or using a person's ability to think in a logical way and understand things 智力的；脑力的；理智的

ex.s: To save their educational and intellectual heritage, the three universities joined together in Kunming as National Southwest Associated University, otherwise known as Lianda.
ex.t: 为保存他们的教育和知识遗产，三所大学在昆明合并为国立西南联合大学，也称为联大。

ex.s: Another value of science is the intellectual enjoyment it can provide us with.
ex.t: 科学的另一个价值是它能够给我们带来的智力享受。

ex.s: Such an effort is, in fact, the first step on the road to that intellectual discipline which forms one of the most important ends of all science.
ex.t: 这样的努力实际上是通往那门智力训练的第一步，这门训练构成了所有科学最重要的目标之一。

ex.s: This knowledge will also be of no small advantage to him if he has passed through more than one intellectual or religious phase, widening the area of his appreciation and realisations.
ex.t: 如果他经历了不止一个知识或宗教阶段，这种知识对他也会有很大益处，拓宽他的欣赏和领悟的范围。

defs.def: well educated and enjoying activities in which you have to think seriously about things 人

ex.s: It should include the social, the industrial and the intellectual life of the nation as well as mere political changes.
ex.t: 它应该包括国家的社会、工业和知识生活，以及单纯的政治变化。
